name: duopore-public-gtin-checksum-audit
description: Spot invalid product barcode numbers before you add them to a product list.

interface.longDescription: Spot invalid product barcode numbers before you add them to a product list. Paste your GTIN barcode numbers as text. Check their length, digits and final check digit. See which numbers need a closer look, while keeping any leading zeros. This checks the number's maths, not who owns it or whether the product is real.
defaultPrompt: Check these product barcode numbers for errors.
Which GTIN numbers have a wrong check digit?
